yt_title: Hummingbird Heart Rate: 1,260 Beats A Minute #Shorts
desc: A hummingbird heart rate can reach 1,260 beats per minute. Researchers recorded it in small, fast flying birds. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: A tiny heart working at top speed! 🐦 Could you keep up? Comment YES or NO. Follow for a fact every day. Send this to a bird lover.

lines.text: A hummingbird heart can beat twelve hundred times a minute.
Researchers recorded up to one thousand two hundred sixty beats in a single minute.
Your heart beats about seventy times a minute at rest.
Its heart is big for its body, and it feeds many times an hour.
That racing heart is why it never sits still. Twelve hundred beats a minute.
